item.title: Debate-Shy: Candidates Increasingly Avoid Sharing the Stage
item.description: Debates were once a staple of political campaigns. Today, candidates often see them as optional or a political liability to avoid.

item.title: Three key questions as GOP faces critical juncture
item.description: With midterms 39 days away and prospects for President Trump's party dimming, leading Republicans say they are concentrating on three major questions.

item.title: Senate Democrats challenge Trump's D.C. renovation plans
item.description: Sen. Jeff Merkley (D-Ore.) plans to force a Senate vote next week on two resolutions aimed at stopping President Trump from demolishing the Kennedy Center.

item.title: NRSC seeks $9M to defend three Republican-held seats
item.description: The Senate GOP campaign arm is making an unusual late request for $8.9 million to defend three red states: Alaska, Iowa and Ohio.
